modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: fine repeatedly branching tunnels with no broad lobes or pellet lining. description.en: Thick branching axes clothed in long, narrow microphylls.
description.zh: 粗壮分枝的轴上密生细长小型叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Baragwanathia longifolia; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Baragwanathia longifolia 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Long leaves along the whole axis produce bottlebrush branches, unlike the high-crowned existing Lepidodendron.
distinctness.zh: 整条枝轴上的长叶形成瓶刷状枝条，区别于现有鳞木的高位树冠。

modeling_brief.en: Build continuous tapering axes with swept leaf blades; simplify leaf count without changing attachment pattern.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立连续渐细枝轴和弯曲叶片；减少叶数时保留着生方式。
